decision: As DEC-EPCE-0006 with the release rule amended per TQ-037: a CWP is released when the documents of its first IWPs are IFC and their materials are on site or confirmed; progressive documents (document types with a progressive share) are released per IWP, needed at CWP start - lead + share x CWP duration; no IWP is issued unless all its documents are IFC and its constraints removed; EWP completeness for the next 8 weeks of IWPs is reported monthly per CWP.
rationale: TQ-037 (Owner accepted); the all-IFC-before-CWP rule was unworkable with the complete MDL.
title: Advanced Work Packaging: CWA / CWP / EWP / PWP / IWP definitions and release rules (Rev B)
